name: coodance
description: Code-as-Video 16:9 Automated Video Production Studio & Pipeline (Web / Windows / macOS)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@coodance/core && npm run build --workspace=@coodance/remotion && npm run build --workspace=@coodance/mcp && npm run build --workspace=@coodance/server && npm run build --workspace=@coodance/web && npm run build --workspace=@coodance/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@coodance/core && npm run build --workspace=@coodance/remotion && npm run build --workspace=@coodance/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace=@coodance/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@coodance/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@coodance/desktop
scripts.desktop:build:win: npm run build && npm run package:win --workspace=@coodance/desktop
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run build && npm run package:mac --workspace=@coodance/desktop
scripts.desktop:build:linux: npm run build && npm run package:linux --workspace=@coodance/desktop
